title: viburnum tinoides var. roraimense
intro: Viburnum tinoides var. roraimense, commonly known as the Roraima Hop Tree, is a plant species belonging to the Viburnum genus. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Viburnum tinoides var. roraimense include its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate immune response, and exhibit antioxidant activity. Research has identified the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
